```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)

library(dplyr) # for mutate, full_join
library(data.table)
library(KongohPlus)

user_name <- params$user_name
dt_csp <- params$dt_csp
fn_csp <- params$fn_csp
fn_af <- params$fn_af
dt_anameth <- params$dt_anameth
fn_anameth <- params$fn_anameth
markers_use <- params$markers_use
data_hnc_list <- params$data_hnc_list
dt_ignore_mk <- params$dt_ignore_mk
hnc_all <- params$hnc_all
message_sr <- params$message_sr
min_size <- params$min_size
max_size <- params$max_size
```

```{r deconvo, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Deconvolution}")
  
  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_log10like <- data_hnc$dt_log10like
    dt_param <- data_hnc$dt_param
    
    cat(sprintf("\\subsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
    
    if(!is.null(dt_log10like) && !is.null(dt_param)){
      warning_message <- data_hnc$warning_message
      if(is.null(warning_message)){
        warning_message <- ""
      }
      warning_message <- paste0(warning_message, message_sr)
    
      # --- Display parameters --- #

      dt_param_display <- copy(dt_param)
      dt_param_display[, Formatted := ifelse(Parameter == "Template amount", 
                                             sprintf("%.0f", `Estimated value`), 
                                             sprintf("%.4f", `Estimated value`))]
      names(dt_param_display) <- c("Parameter", "Contributor", "Replicate", "DNU", "Estimated value")
      dt_param_display <- dt_param_display[, .(Parameter, Contributor, Replicate, `Estimated value`)]
      dt_param_display$Contributor[is.na(dt_param_display$Contributor)] <- ""
      dt_param_display$Replicate[is.na(dt_param_display$Replicate)] <- ""
  
      cat("\\subsubsection*{Parameters}")
    
      tb <- kable(
        dt_param_display, 
        format = "latex", 
        booktabs = TRUE, 
        row.names = FALSE, 
        align = c("l", "l", "l", "r"),
        escape = TRUE, 
        float = FALSE, 
        linesep = "", 
        na = "")
      tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "7.2cm")
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "2.4cm")
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 3, width = "2.4cm")
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 4, width = "3.6cm")
      print(tb)
    
      cat("\n\n")
      
      base_size <- dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Subcategory == "Base size"]
      graph_eph <- create_fig_eph(dt_param, min_size, max_size, base_size)
      print(graph_eph)
    
      # --- Display likelihoods ---- #
    
      dt_log10like[, `Log10 (Likelihood)` := formatC(Log10_Likelihood, format = "f", digits = 4)]
    
      cat("\\clearpage")
      cat("\\subsubsection*{Likelihood}")
    
      tb <- kable(
        dt_log10like[, .(Marker, `Log10 (Likelihood)`)], 
        format = "latex", 
        booktabs = TRUE, 
        longtable = TRUE, 
        row.names = FALSE, 
        align = c("l", "r"),
        escape = TRUE, 
        float = FALSE, 
        linesep = ""
      )
      tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "4.8cm")
      tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "4.8cm")
      print(tb)
    
      # --- Display warning messages --- #
    
      cat("\\subsubsection*{Warnings}")
    
      if(warning_message == ""){
        cat("None")
      }else{
        warning_message <- gsub("<br>", "\\\\\n", warning_message)
        warning_message <- gsub("&nbsp; &nbsp; ", "\\\\hspace{2em}", warning_message)
        cat(warning_message)
      }
    }
    
    else{
      error_message <- data_hnc$error_message
      error_message <- gsub("<br>", "\\\\\n", error_message)
      cat(error_message)
    }
    
    if(i != length(hnc_all)){
      cat("\\clearpage")
    }
  }
}
```

```{r pg_per_comb, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Probabilistic genotyping (per combination)}")
  
  n_mk_use <- length(markers_use)

  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_pg_list <- data_hnc$dt_pg_list
    
    if(!is.null(dt_pg_list)){
      cat(sprintf("\\subsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
      
      for(j in 1:n_mk_use){
        mk <- markers_use[j]
        dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_list[[mk]]
    
        # --- Extract up to the point where the total probability exceeds 'gt_prob_sum' --- #
    
        cumprob <- cumsum(dt_pg_per_comb$Probability)
    
        # Get the first row number where the total exceeds 'gt_prob_sum'
        cutoff_index <- which.max(cumprob > gt_prob_sum)
    
        # If there are no values exceeding 'gt_prob_sum', use all rows.
        if(cutoff_index == 0){
          cutoff_index <- nrow(dt_pg_per_comb$Probability)
        }
    
        # Extract
        dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[1:cutoff_index]
    
        # --- Extract displayed columns --- #
    
        dt_pg_per_comb <- dt_pg_per_comb[, which(is.element(names(dt_pg_per_comb), c(paste0("U", 1:hnc), "Probability"))), with = FALSE]
    
        # --- Display the table --- #
    
        cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{%s}\n", mk))
    
        tb <- kable(dt_pg_per_comb, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
        tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
        tb <- column_spec(tb, 1:ncol(dt_pg_per_comb), width = "2.4cm")
        print(tb)
    
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r pg_per_contrib, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(data_hnc_list)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Probabilistic genotyping (per contributor)}")
  
  n_mk_use <- length(markers_use)

  for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
    hnc <- hnc_all[i]
    data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
    dt_pg_list <- data_hnc$dt_pg_list
    
    if(!is.null(dt_pg_list)){
      cat(sprintf("\\subsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
  
      for(j in 1:hnc){
    
        dt_pg_per_contrib_all <- NULL
        cut_positions <- rep(NA, n_mk_use)
      
        cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{Contributor %s (U%s)}\n", j, j))
    
        for(k in 1:n_mk_use){
      
          mk <- markers_use[k]
          dt_pg_per_contrib <- aggregate_pg_contrib(dt_pg_list[[mk]], paste0("U", j))
        
          # --- Extract up to the point where the total probability exceeds 'gt_prob_sum' --- #
    
          cumprob <- cumsum(dt_pg_per_contrib$Probability)
        
          # Get the first row number where the total exceeds 'gt_prob_sum'
          cutoff_index <- which.max(cumprob > gt_prob_sum)
    
          # If there are no values exceeding 'gt_prob_sum', use all rows.
          if(cutoff_index == 0){
            cutoff_index <- nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib$Probability)
          }
    
          # Extract
          dt_pg_per_contrib <- dt_pg_per_contrib[1:cutoff_index, ]

          # --- Add a column for the marker --- #
        
          col_mk <- rep("", nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib))
          col_mk[1] <- mk
      
          dt_pg_per_contrib <- cbind(col_mk, dt_pg_per_contrib)
          names(dt_pg_per_contrib)[1] <- "Marker"
        
          dt_pg_per_contrib_all <- rbind(dt_pg_per_contrib_all, dt_pg_per_contrib)
        
          cut_positions[k] <- nrow(dt_pg_per_contrib_all)
        }
      
        names(dt_pg_per_contrib_all) <- c("Marker", "Genotype", "Probability")
      
        cut_positions <- cut_positions[-n_mk_use]
      
        # --- Display the table --- #  
    
        tb <- kable(dt_pg_per_contrib_all, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
        tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
        tb <- column_spec(tb, 1:ncol(dt_pg_per_contrib_all), width = "2.4cm")
        tb <- row_spec(tb, cut_positions, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule")
        print(tb)
    
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r csp, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(dt_csp)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Crime stain profile}")
  
  sn_csp_all <- unique(dt_csp[, SampleName])
  n_rep <- length(sn_csp_all)
  df_csp_rep <- data.frame("Replicate" = as.character(1:n_rep), 
                           "Sample Name" = sn_csp_all, 
                           check.names = FALSE)

  tb <- kable(df_csp_rep, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
  tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "2.4cm")
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "13.4cm")
  print(tb)
  cat("\n\n")

  dt_display_csp <- create_dt_display_csp(dt_csp)

  dt_display_csp[, g := cumsum(!is.na(Marker))]

  tmp_markers <- dt_display_csp$Marker
  tmp_markers[is.na(tmp_markers)] <- ""
  dt_display_csp$Marker <- tmp_markers

  ends <- dt_display_csp[g > 0, .(end = .I[.N]), by = g]$end
  cut_positions <- if (length(ends) > 1) ends[-length(ends)] else integer(0)

  n_table_csp <- (n_rep - 1) %/% 4 + 1
  for(i in 1:n_table_csp){
    cand_height_label <- paste0("Height", (4 * (i - 1) + 1):(4 * i))
    index_display <- which(is.element(names(dt_display_csp), c("Marker", "Allele", cand_height_label)))
  
    tb <- kable(
      dt_display_csp[, index_display, with = FALSE], 
      format = "latex", 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      longtable = TRUE, 
      row.names = FALSE, 
      align = c("l", rep("r", length(index_display) - 1)), 
      escape = TRUE, 
      float = FALSE, 
      linesep = ""
    )
    tb <- kable_styling(
      tb, 
      latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), 
      position = "left", 
      full_width = FALSE
    )
    tb <- row_spec(
      tb,
      cut_positions, 
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule"
    )
    tb <- column_spec(
      tb, 
      1:length(index_display), 
      width = "2.4cm"
    )
    print(tb)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r ref, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

if(!is.null(dt_ref)){
  cat("\\clearpage")
  cat("\\section*{Reference profile}")
  
  dt_ref_display <- NULL
  samples <- unique(dt_ref$SampleName)
  n_sample <- length(samples)
  for(i in 1:n_sample){
    dt_tmp <- dt_ref[dt_ref$SampleName == samples[i]]

    gts <- rep(NA, nrow(dt_tmp))
    for(j in 1:nrow(dt_tmp)){
      gt1 <- c(dt_tmp$Allele1[j], dt_tmp$Allele2[j])
      gt1 <- gt1[!is.na(gt1)]
      gts[j] <- paste0(gt1, collapse = ", ")
    }

    dt_tmp2 <- data.table(Marker = dt_tmp$Marker,
                          Gt = gts)
    names(dt_tmp2) <- c("Marker", samples[i])

    if(i == 1){
      dt_ref_display <- dt_tmp2
    }else{
      dt_ref_display <- full_join(dt_ref_display, dt_tmp2, by = c("Marker"))
    }
  }
  
  n_table_ref <- (n_sample - 1) %/% 5 + 1
  for(i in 1:n_table_ref){
    if(i == n_table_ref){
      samples_display <- samples[(5 * (i - 1) + 1):length(samples)]
    }else{
      samples_display <- samples[(5 * (i - 1) + 1):(5 * i)]
    }
    index_display <- which(is.element(names(dt_ref_display), c("Marker", samples_display)))
    
    tb <- kable(
      dt_ref_display[, index_display, with = FALSE], 
      format = "latex", 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      longtable = TRUE, 
      row.names = FALSE, 
      escape = TRUE, 
      float = FALSE, 
      linesep = ""
    )
    tb <- kable_styling(
      tb, 
      latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), 
      position = "left", 
      full_width = FALSE
    )
    tb <- column_spec(
      tb, 
      1:length(index_display), 
      width = "2.4cm"
    )
    print(tb)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r anameth, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
  cat("\\subsection*{Locus specific amplification efficiency}")
  
  dt_lsae <- data.table(Marker = dt_anameth$Subcategory[dt_anameth$Category == "LSAE"], 
                        LSAE = dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Category == "LSAE"])
  
  tb <- kable(dt_lsae, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
  tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "4.8cm")
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "11cm")
  print(tb)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("\\subsection*{Peak height parameter}")
  
  dt_gamma <- data.table(A = dt_anameth$Subcategory[dt_anameth$Category == "Peak height"], 
                         B = dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Category == "Peak height"])
  
  tb <- kable(dt_gamma, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
  tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "4.8cm")
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "11cm")
  print(tb)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("\\subsection*{Drop-in parameter}")
  
  dt_dropin <- data.table(A = dt_anameth$Subcategory[dt_anameth$Category == "Drop-in"], 
                          B = dt_anameth$Value[dt_anameth$Category == "Drop-in"])
  
  tb <- kable(dt_dropin, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
  tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 1, width = "4.8cm")
  tb <- column_spec(tb, 2, width = "11cm")
  print(tb)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  cat("\\subsection*{Stutter ratio}")
  
  dt_sr <- data.table(Marker = dt_anameth$Subcategory[dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      Allele = dt_anameth$Allele[dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      BSR = dt_anameth[["Average BSR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      FSR = dt_anameth[["Average FSR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      DSR = dt_anameth[["Average DSR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"], 
                      M2SR = dt_anameth[["Average M2SR"]][dt_anameth$Category == "SR"])
  markers_sr <- unique(dt_sr$Marker)
  for(i in 1:length(markers_sr)){
    cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{%s}\n", markers_sr[i]))
    
    dt_sr_mk <- dt_sr[dt_sr$Marker == markers_sr[i]]
    dt_sr_mk[, c("Marker") := NULL]
    
    tb <- kable(dt_sr_mk, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE, float = FALSE, linesep = "")
    tb <- kable_styling(tb, latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"), position = "left", full_width = FALSE)
    tb <- column_spec(tb, 1:5, width = "2.4cm")
    print(tb)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
